result.reason: The operative language includes all preferred coverages and limits, workers’ compensation as required by law, and certificates on request. However, it exceeds the playbook by requiring all coverage for one year after expiration and by triggering cyber coverage for access to broadly described Corio or customer data rather than the defined Customer Data processing condition. The insertion also leaves Section 14.10 after Section 14.11 and after the execution preamble, which should be corrected. The unrelated bankruptcy and integration terms remain substantively unchanged.
